title: Acquisition pipeline and due diligence
status: gate met - AC-1..AC-5 met: a stage advance records actor, date and rationale; open diligence blocks the move out of due diligence and later; the rights matrix keeps mineral, surface and working interest apart; a declined opportunity keeps its history; and money is a decimal with an explicit currency. The pipeline records also implement the lost-acknowledgement state (the original is retained and retried unchanged).

dataModel.decision: The LeaseAcquisition module had no persistence for the pipeline, diligence, rights or negotiation: its service partials return hard-coded projections and the only table is LEASE_ACQUISITION. The plan's own contract (OgLeaseOpportunity, OgDiligenceItem) and its acceptance criteria were implemented as four LeaseAcquisition-owned tables, the same pattern used for WELL_PROGRAM in EXP-05.
tables: LEASE_PIPELINE_STAGE (STAGE_ID key, LEASE_ID, STAGE_SEQ_NO, STAGE, OUTCOME, RATIONALE, ACTOR, DECIDED_AT) - append-only history; the current stage is the highest sequence
LEASE_DILIGENCE_ITEM (ITEM_ID key, LEASE_ID, CATEGORY, QUESTION, OUTCOME, EVIDENCE_REF, REVIEWER, REVIEWED_AT) - an empty or OPEN outcome blocks an advance
LEASE_RIGHT (RIGHT_ID key, LEASE_ID, RIGHT_TYPE, OWNER, INTEREST_PERCENT, EFFECTIVE_DATE, EXPIRY_DATE) - the mineral/surface/working matrix
LEASE_NEGOTIATION (NEGOTIATION_ID key, LEASE_ID, ROUND_NO, COUNTERPARTY, OFFER_AMOUNT, CURRENCY, NOTES, ACTOR, RECORDED_AT)
dataModel.registration: Beep.OilandGas.LeaseAcquisition/Modules/LeaseAcquisitionModule.cs now registers the four types, so module setup creates them.
dataModel.keys: Each table carries [Key] on its own generated id; LEASE_ACQUISITION.LEASE_ACQUISITION_ID also gained [Key]. OgUow now falls back to '<entity>_ID' then 'ID' when a provider records no key, so an update can still find its row.

implementation.service: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Data/Lease/OgLeasePipeline.cs (LeasePipelineStage rules, OgLeaseOpportunity, OgDiligenceItem, OgLeaseRight, OgNegotiationEntry, OgPipelineHistoryEntry, OgPipelineCard/Column/Snapshot/Detail, OgPipelineDecision, IOgLeasePipeline, OgLeasePipelineService)
implementation.page: src/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop/Views/LeasePipelinePageView.cs (route 'leasepipeline': board grid, stage summary, detail with diligence/rights/negotiation/history, record diligence, record negotiation, advance, decline, retry)
implementation.wiring: OgBootstrapper (IOgLeasePipeline), OgApplication.LeasePipeline, catalog 'leasepipeline' (OgModuleKeys.Lease), OgPageFactory, en + ar labels
implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/LeasePipelineTests.cs (9, no database) + LeasePipelineGatewayTests.cs (1 opt-in, real SQLite)

commands.warnings: owner-project analyzer warnings only; the desktop projects add none

integration.database: SQLite with LEASE_ACQUISITION plus the four pipeline tables, seeded in LeasePipelineGatewayTests
integration.board: three opportunities for F-1 (OP-1 OPPORTUNITY, OP-2 DUE_DILIGENCE, OP-3 no stage), the fourth in another field absent; the unclassified column contains OP-3
integration.detail: OP-1 reads '1,000 USD' for the asking price, mineral 1 / surface 1 / working 1, one negotiation round ('900 USD') and one history entry
integration.ac2_block: advancing OP-2 out of DUE_DILIGENCE with an open 'Is the title clear?' item is refused with lease-pipeline-diligence-open and the item is named
integration.ac2_release: closing that item with PASS and DOC-1 drops the open count to 0; the same advance then succeeds
integration.ac1_recorded: the advance writes a LEASE_PIPELINE_STAGE row with STAGE=NEGOTIATION, ACTOR=sara, DECIDED_AT and RATIONALE='diligence is complete', and updates LEASE_ACQUISITION.ACQUISITION_STATUS to NEGOTIATION
integration.negotiation: a round without a counterparty is refused (lease-pipeline-counterparty-required) and a round without a currency is refused (lease-pipeline-currency-required); no row is written in either case
integration.ac4_decline: declining OP-1 writes DECLINED as a second history entry; the original OPPORTUNITY entry is still present with its rationale
integration.lost_ack: a SQLite trigger made the stage insert fail for OP-3: the change was refused, Pending retained the exact decision, no row was written; after the trigger was dropped, RetryAsync recorded the same stage, rationale and actor

gates.AC-1 Stage advance records actor, date a: pass - the advance writes ACTOR, DECIDED_AT and RATIONALE on LEASE_PIPELINE_STAGE and the detail reads them back; a blank rationale is refused with lease-pipeline-rationale-required.
gates.AC-2 Diligence items block advance while: pass - from DUE_DILIGENCE onward, any item with no outcome or OPEN refuses the move with lease-pipeline-diligence-open and names the open questions; the SQLite test proves the block and the release after closing the item.
gates.AC-3 Rights matrix distinguishes mineral: pass - OgLeaseRight carries the typed RIGHT_TYPE and the detail groups MineralRights/SurfaceRights/WorkingInterest; the SQLite test seeds one of each and reads 'mineral 1 / surface 1 / working 1'. The matrix is read-only in this build; the feature's command table has no rights command.
gates.AC-4 A declined opportunity keeps its hi: pass - decline is the same append-only AdvanceAsync with DECLINED; the SQLite test sees both the earlier OPPORTUNITY entry and the DECLINED entry.
gates.AC-5 Money values are decimal with an ex: pass - OgLeaseOpportunity carries decimal AskingPrice and Currency and prints '(currency not recorded)' when absent; a negotiation round refuses a blank currency; the test reads '1,000 USD' and '900 USD'.

limits: The board is a grid with a stage summary, not a drag-and-drop kanban; the stage rule is the single service command, and the grid's columns show the same stages.
The rights matrix is read-only: LSE-02's command table has diligence, negotiation and advance/decline, and no rights command. Editing rights belongs to a later feature.
The pipeline has no document store; EVIDENCE_REF on a diligence item is the reference the reviewer records, not an uploaded file.
The stage order is a fixed constant (OPPORTUNITY..EXECUTED plus DECLINED); a configurable stage model is not part of the feature.
The asking price is read from LEASE_ACQUISITION.BONUS_AMOUNT/BONUS_AMOUNT_OUOM; an opportunity with no bonus amount shows 'no asking price recorded'.
The new tables need the LEASE_ACQUISITION module applied again on an existing database to be created.
